INTERPRETATION RULES

What this can establish

  • The PO export has no unit field. Main diesel quantities are interpreted as ordered gallons from the product and bid context; they do not prove delivery.
  • Posted invoice totals cover all lines on the PO, including tax, additives, or other fuels.
  • The public files do not include bills of lading, scanned invoices, or the proprietary daily contract index.
  • Review candidates indicate a record question, not proven overbilling or recovered savings.
How the records are connected +

Orders are selected by vendor account and diesel product; the public PO export does not carry the agreement ID, so the link to the award is contextual. PO lines are grouped by PO ID. Posted invoice journals join on PO ID, and amounts are counted once per distinct invoice and PO pair. The comparison uses all PO lines, including tax and biodiesel when present. “No match” means no invoice entry appeared in the loaded 2026 file; it may appear in another year.
